notes.title: Playtest Version Released!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, we’re Snako Production![/p][p]After two years of dedicated development, we’re thrilled to reveal our game: GOLDEN SWIRL![/p][p][/p][p]GOLDEN SWIRL is a dark fantasy adventure that blends roguelike deckbuilding, fast-paced action combat, and deep strategic gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 Next, we’ll be running a Playtest, and we’d love for you to join in, try it out early, and share your feedback. Later, we’ll release a free demo so more players can experience the game.[/p][p][/p][p]🙏 One small favor: if you’re interested in GOLDEN SWIRL, please consider adding it to your Steam Wishlist. It means a lot to a small indie team like us.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/AX8gB63Hub"]https://discord.gg/AX8gB63Hub[/url][/p][p]👉 X: [url="https://x.com/snakoproduction"]https://x.com/snakoproduction[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely hope this game brings you a unique dark fantasy adventure—and thank you so much for all your support![/p]
